note: ADR 1047: an action step resumes on the same stack after a yield of a non-thenable value, so an effect created in an IIFE or a closure the resumed step runs, from an action called in an effect apply, has no owner: NO_OWNER_EFFECT at each (main had the IIFE and closure sites uncertifiable, function-run-unplaced); a call after the yield under an untaken branch never runs (quiet), and a generator stepped by hand stays uncertifiable
